# Ant Design Vue

> Ant Design Vue (`@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue`) is an enterprise-class UI component library for Vue 3 (75 components + 6 new 4.3.0 subcomponents), implementing the Ant Design system with Vue 3 Composition API, Single File Components (`<script setup>`), TypeScript, CSS-in-JS dynamic theming with native CSS Variables enabled by default in 4.3.0+, 317+ Component Design Tokens, 72 `ConfigProvider` component configs, and functional Semantic DOM (`classNames`/`styles`).

Ant Design Vue 4.3.0 is built from the ground up for Vue 3. It uses CSS-in-JS dynamic styling with native `--ant-*` CSS Variables enabled by default (plus optional `zeroRuntime` static CSS extraction via `npm run static-style-extract`), offers complete TypeScript definitions, 317+ component-level Design Tokens, interactive Semantic DOM customization across 31 components, and supports modern frontend tooling (Vite, Rsbuild, Webpack).

## Critical Guidelines for LLMs & AI Coding Agents

When generating Vue 3 code using `@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue`, agents MUST follow these principles to avoid hallucinations:

1. **Vue 3 SFC `<script setup lang="ts">`**: Always use `<script setup lang="ts">` and Composition API (`ref`, `reactive`, `computed`, `watch`).
2. **Component Imports**: Import components directly from `'@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue'`:
   ```ts
   import { Button, Table, Form, Input, Modal, message } from '@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue';
   ```
   Or use registered template tags `<a-button>`, `<a-table>`, `<a-form>`, etc. (4.3.0 subcomponents register as `<a-alert-error-boundary>`, `<a-checkable-tag-group>`, `<a-cascader-panel>`, `<a-statistic-timer>`, `<a-space-addon>`, `<a-tooltip-unique-provider>`).
3. **Icon Imports**: Icons MUST be imported from `'@ant-design/icons-vue'`. NEVER import icons from `'@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue'` or `'@ant-design/icons'`.
   ```ts
   import { SearchOutlined, UserOutlined, DownOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons-vue';
   ```
4. **Zero CSS Imports (CSS-in-JS)**: Ant Design Vue 4.x generates styles on demand in JavaScript. DO NOT import CSS or Less files like `import '@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue/dist/antd.css'` or `import '@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue/es/style/css'`.
5. **Form Data Binding (`v-model:value`)**: Form controls bind to values via `v-model:value`, NOT `v-model`.
   ```vue
   <a-input v-model:value="formState.username" />
   <a-select v-model:value="formState.role" :options="roleOptions" />
   ```
6. **Dialog & Overlay Visibility (`v-model:open`)**: Modals, Drawers, Tooltips, Popovers, Dropdowns, and Image previews (`preview.open`) control visibility with `open`, NOT `visible` (deprecated).
   ```vue
   <a-modal v-model:open="isModalOpen" title="Details">...</a-modal>
   <a-drawer v-model:open="isDrawerOpen" title="Menu">...</a-drawer>
   ```
7. **Context & Feedback (`<a-app>`)**: Wrap applications with `<a-app>` so that modal, message, and notification hooks have access to Vue reactive contexts and theme tokens:
   ```vue
   <template>
     <a-app>
       <MyView />
     </a-app>
   </template>
   <script setup lang="ts">
   import { App } from '@hiltonkohler21/ant-design-vue';
   const { message, modal, notification } = App.useApp();
   </script>
   ```
8. **Theme Customization, CSS Variables (`token` vs `realToken`) & 317+ Component Design Tokens**: Use `<a-config-provider :theme="{ token, components }">` and `theme.useToken()`. Under default `cssVar: true` in `4.3.0+`, `token.value.*` returns CSS variable strings (`var(--ant-*)`) that already include units — assign them directly to CSS properties without appending `px`, and destructure `realToken` from `theme.useToken()` whenever JS numeric math or Canvas/SVG/ECharts colors are required:
   ```vue
   <a-config-provider
     :theme="{
       token: { colorPrimary: '#1677ff', borderRadius: 6 },
       components: { Button: { fontWeight: 600 }, Alert: { defaultPadding: '10px 14px' } },
     }"
   >
     <router-view />
   </a-config-provider>
   ```
9. **Semantic DOM (`classNames` & `styles`)**: 31 components support structured `classNames` and `styles` props accepting either a static object or a dynamic function `({ props }) => ({ ... })`, replacing legacy `bodyStyle` / `headStyle` / `maskStyle` props. See [Common Props](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/common-props) and each component's `#semantic-dom` previewer.

## Documentation & Guides
- [Quick Start](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/getting-started): Installation, Vite/Rsbuild integration, and baseline configuration.
- [Use in Vite](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/use-with-vite): Vite setup, on-demand auto-import, CSS Variables, and TailwindCSS v4 `@layer` guidance.
- [4.2.6 → 4.3.0 Migration Guide](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/migration-v43): Complete upgrade handbook covering default `cssVar: true` (`token` vs `realToken`), `zeroRuntime`, 6 new components, 6 new subcomponents, `List` → `Listy`, Semantic DOM, 72 `ConfigProvider` configs, 317+ component tokens, and backwards-compatible v6 API mappings.
- [Common Props & Semantic DOM](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/common-props): Standardized `rootClassName`, static & functional `classNames`/`styles` across 31 semantic-enabled components, `variant`, `destroyOnHidden`, and 72 `ConfigProvider` component defaults.
- [Customize Theme](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/customize-theme): Seed/Map/Alias tokens, 317+ Component Design Tokens, algorithms, and dynamic theme switching.
- [SSR & Static Style Extraction](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/ssr-extract-ssr): Server-side rendering with `extractStyle` + `extractCSSVarStyle`, Nuxt 3, and `zeroRuntime` static extraction.
- [For AI Agents](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/for-agents): Authoritative instructions, rulesets, and prompts for Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and Antigravity.
- [MCP Server](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/docs/vue/mcp): Model Context Protocol setup and tool reference.
- [Design Specification](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/design.md): Design values, token hierarchy (317+ component tokens), Semantic DOM rules, and UI guidelines.

## Component Index

### General
- [Button](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/button): Trigger actions with `variant` (`outlined`/`dashed`/`solid`/`filled`/`text`/`link`), `color` (incl. 13 presets), `iconPlacement`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Icon](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/icon): Semantic vector icons loaded from `@ant-design/icons-vue`.
- [Typography](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/typography): Headings, paragraphs, text with copy, edit, italic, and ellipsis support.

### Layout
- [Divider](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/divider): Horizontal or vertical content separators (`orientation`, `vertical`, `titlePlacement`, `variant`, `size`, semantic `classNames`/`styles`).
- [Flex](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/flex): CSS Flexbox layout component with `gap`, `align`, `justify`, and `orientation`.
- [Grid](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/grid): 24-column grid system (`a-row` and `a-col`) with responsive breakpoints.
- [Layout](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/layout): Page structural layout (`a-layout`, `a-layout-header`, `a-layout-sider`, `a-layout-content`, `a-layout-footer`).
- [Masonry](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/masonry): Responsive multi-column waterfall layout with shortest-column packing, image load/error reflow, `fresh`, `MasonryRef`, and functional `classNames`/`styles` (new in 4.3.0).
- [Space](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/space): Uniform spacing (`orientation`, `separator`, semantic `classNames`/`styles`) plus **`Space.Addon`** (`<a-space-addon>`, new in 4.3.0) for `<a-space-compact>`.
- [Splitter](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/splitter): Draggable and collapsible pane splitters (`orientation`, `collapsibleIcon`, `draggerIcon`, `onDraggerDoubleClick`, functional `classNames`/`styles`).

### Navigation
- [Anchor](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/anchor): Hyperlink scrolling navigation for in-page sections.
- [Breadcrumb](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/breadcrumb): Hierarchical page location indicator with config-driven `items` and `dropdownIcon`.
- [Dropdown](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/dropdown): Contextual drop-down menu lists with `popupRender`, `destroyOnHidden`, and `autoAdjustOverflow`.
- [Menu](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/menu): Navigation menu with inline, vertical, and horizontal layouts.
- [PageHeader](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/page-header): Top-level page header with back button, breadcrumbs, tags, and actions.
- [Pagination](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/pagination): Page navigation for large datasets.
- [Steps](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/steps): Linear process step-by-step navigation (`orientation`, `titlePlacement`, `variant`, `ellipsis`, `items[].content`, functional `classNames`/`styles`).

### Data Entry
- [AutoComplete](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/auto-complete): Text input with query-based autocompletion, `variant`, `popupRender`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Cascader](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/cascader): Multi-level hierarchical dropdown selection plus **`Cascader.Panel`** (`<a-cascader-panel>`, new in 4.3.0) for inline multi-column selection.
- [Checkbox](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/checkbox): Multi-selection checkboxes and checkbox groups.
- [ColorPicker](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/color-picker): Visual solid & gradient color picker supporting HEX, RGB, and HSB modes.
- [DatePicker](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/date-picker): Single, range, and `multiple` date picker with `variant` and `needConfirm`.
- [Form](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/form): Form validation, layout, `variant` propagation to child inputs, and reactive state management (`v-model:value`).
- [Input](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/input): Text input, password input, search input (`searchIcon`), OTP input (`Input.OTP` / `<a-input-otp>`), and textareas with `variant` and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [InputNumber](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/input-number): Controlled numerical input with `prefix`/`suffix`, `changeOnWheel`, and `variant`.
- [Mentions](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/mentions): Text input with `@mention` trigger support and `variant`.
- [Radio](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/radio): Single-selection radio inputs and button groups (`block`, `orientation`/`vertical`).
- [Rate](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/rate): Star rating component with `size` (`small`/`middle`/`medium`/`large`).
- [Select](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/select): Single, multiple, and tags dropdown selection with `variant`, `popupRender`, `prefix`/`suffix`, `loadingIcon`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Slider](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/slider): Single value or range slider with unified `tooltip` config object, `orientation`, `onChangeComplete`, `handleRender`, and semantic `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Switch](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/switch): Two-state toggle switch for boolean settings.
- [TimePicker](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/time-picker): Time selection popup with `variant` and `needConfirm`.
- [Transfer](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/transfer): Double-column transfer control with `actions`, `deselectAll`, `selectionsIcon`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [TreeSelect](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tree-select): Hierarchical tree structure dropdown selector with `variant`, `popupRender`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Upload](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/upload): File and image drag-and-drop or button uploader.

### Data Display
- [Avatar](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/avatar): Profile picture or initials display with `Avatar.Group` `max` object config.
- [Badge](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/badge): Numerical badges and status dots with functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Calendar](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/calendar): Full-sized or card-sized month and year calendar.
- [Card](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/card): Container for grouped information with `variant` and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Carousel](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/carousel): Slideshow / carousel with `dotPlacement` and `autoplay.dotDuration`.
- [Collapse](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/collapse): Accordion collapsible panels with `size`, `expandIconPlacement`, `destroyOnHidden`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Comment](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/comment): Discussion comment box with author, avatar, datetime, and reply actions.
- [Descriptions](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/descriptions): Label-value list format with config-driven `items` (incl. `'filled'` and responsive `span`) and semantic `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Empty](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/empty): Empty state placeholder with functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Image](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/image): Image viewer with `preview.open`/`onOpenChange`, `actionsRender`, `imageRender`, `mask` blur, functional `classNames`/`styles`, and **`Image.PreviewGroup.items`** (new in 4.3.0).
- [List](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/list): Legacy list presentation (prefer `Listy` for modern virtualized lists).
- [Listy](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/listy): High-performance list container with `items`, `rowKey`, `group`, `sticky`, `scrollWidth`, virtual scrolling, imperative `scrollTo`, and functional `classNames`/`styles` (new in 4.3.0).
- [Popover](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/popover): Card-like floating panel with functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [QRCode](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/qrcode): Canvas or SVG based QR code generator with status handling.
- [Segmented](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/segmented): Linear segmented control with `shape`, `orientation`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Statistic](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/statistic): Formatted numerical indicators, countdowns, and **`Statistic.Timer`** (`<a-statistic-timer>`, new in 4.3.0) supporting both `countdown` and `countup`.
- [Table](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/table): Feature-rich data table with `virtual` scrolling, `column.hidden`, `sortIcon`, `filterOnClose`, and `filterDropdownProps`.
- [Tabs](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tabs): Tabbed navigation with config-driven `items`, `tabPlacement`, `more`, `indicator`, and `destroyOnHidden`.
- [Tag](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tag): Colored badges (`variant`, `disabled`, `href`/`target`, `closable` object, functional `classNames`/`styles`) plus **`Tag.CheckableTagGroup`** (`<a-checkable-tag-group>`, new in 4.3.0).
- [Timeline](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/timeline): Chronological event flow with config-driven `items`, `orientation` (`horizontal`/`vertical`), `variant` (`filled`/`outlined`), and `titleSpan`.
- [Tooltip](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tooltip): Contextual text hint with functional `classNames`/`styles` plus **`Tooltip.UniqueProvider`** (`<a-tooltip-unique-provider>`, new in 4.3.0) for smooth sibling transitions.
- [Tour](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tour): Step-by-step guided walkthrough with `indicatorsRender`, `actionsRender`, and `keyboard` navigation.
- [Tree](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/tree): Collapsible hierarchical tree view with checkboxes and drag-and-drop.

### Feedback
- [Alert](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/alert): Contextual message banners (`title`, `variant="filled"`, `closable` object, functional `classNames`/`styles`) plus **`Alert.ErrorBoundary`** (`<a-alert-error-boundary>`, new in 4.3.0).
- [Drawer](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/drawer): Slide-out overlay panel (`v-model:open`, `resizable`, `loading`, `afterOpenChange`, `closable`/`mask` objects, semantic `classNames`/`styles`).
- [Message](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/message): Global transient toast notification (`App.useApp()`).
- [Modal](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/modal): Modal dialog popup (`v-model:open`, `loading`, `closable`/`mask` objects, `destroyOnHidden`, semantic `classNames`/`styles`).
- [Notification](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/notification): Corner notification card with `stack`, `showProgress`, `pauseOnHover`, `actions`, and `closable` object (`App.useApp()`).
- [Popconfirm](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/popconfirm): Lightweight confirmation balloon with functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Progress](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/progress): Circular and linear progress indicators (`percentPosition`, `rounding`, `gapPlacement`, `railColor`, functional `classNames`/`styles`).
- [Result](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/result): Success, error, 404, 403, and 500 status screens.
- [Skeleton](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/skeleton): Animated loading placeholder outlines.
- [Spin](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/spin): Loading indicator with `description`, `percent="auto"`, `fullscreen`, and functional `classNames`/`styles`.
- [Watermark](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/watermark): Security watermark overlay with `onRemove`, per-line styled `content`, and `inherit`.

### Other
- [Affix](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/affix): Stick an element to the viewport when scrolling past a threshold.
- [App](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/app): App-level context wrapper providing theme tokens and feedback hooks.
- [BackTop](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/back-top): Legacy scroll-to-top button (prefer `FloatButton.BackTop`).
- [BorderBeam](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/border-beam): Animated gradient comet beam flowing along a container's rounded border (new in 4.3.0).
- [ConfigProvider](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/config-provider): Global provider for themes, CSS variables, zero-runtime mode, 72 per-component defaults, locales, prefixCls, and direction.
- [FloatButton](https://hiltonkohler21.github.io/ant-design-vue/components/float-button): Floating action button, `FloatButton.BackTop`, and directional `FloatButton.Group` (`placement`, `items`, `content`).
